name: Cooper City AC Repair Services
address_source: No street address published anywhere (Google Business Profile shows no address field, consistent with a mobile/service-area HVAC technician). Reviews place the business in Cooper City, FL (Broward County); one reviewer (Pablo de los Santos) explicitly calls it a 'Local Cooper City owned business'. Per the adapted-variant rule, the map/address section was omitted and replaced with a real work photo instead.
phone_source: Google Business Profile (gmaps_detail.js extraction of the authoritative Maps ficha), also printed on a real third-party marketing flyer photo in the business's own GBP photo album.
has_own_site_evidence: Verified NO own website. (1) Google Business Profile shows 'Add website' (no website button/link at all) and the authority-link selector (a[data-item-id="authority"]) returned null on a fresh gmaps_detail.js read. (2) curl -I on coopercityacrepair.com, coopercityac.com, coopercityacrepairservices.com: all returned connect_unreachable / no public DNS record. (3) WebSearch "Cooper City AC Repair Services" website and "Cooper City AC Repair Services" Danny instagram OR facebook: no official site or social profile found for this specific business; only unrelated Cooper City-area HVAC competitors (Lindstrom Air, Fleming Brothers, Signature Air Conditioning, East Coast Cooling, Cooling on Demand) surfaced, none matching this business's name/phone.

social_media.evidence: WebSearch for an Instagram or Facebook profile matching this exact business name (and technician first name Danny) returned nothing. No social links on the Google Business Profile. Not pursued further per the adapted-variant rule (no social channel exists to use for outreach or extra photos).

email_search_note: Deep search performed, no public email found: Google Business Profile has no email field, no linked website to host a contact form, no Facebook/Instagram About section to check, and WebSearch for Sunbiz/Florida Division of Corporations or directory listings (Angi, HomeGuide, BBB) under this exact business name did not surface one either. Consistent with FORGE-BRIEF's observation that home-service trades rarely publish email; phone (call/text) is the real channel here.

google_business.hours: Monday-Friday, open 24 hours; Saturday and Sunday closed (per live Google Business Profile hours).
google_business.about_text_source: GBP 'From the owner' field (verbatim): "AC Master. Complete Air Conditioning Solutions." Used as the site's tagline, unchanged.
google_business.service_mentions_source: Google's own review-summary tag cloud on the listing: punctuality (5 reviews), issue diagnosis (3), efficient repair (3), fair pricing (4), clear explanations (4), quality of work (2), reliability (7), responsiveness (2), technician (5), honesty (5). Used as the grounding for all adapted copy (hero, experience, method sections).

services_source: No price list published anywhere (no own website, no booking platform). Service categories below are grounded in the GBP category ('Air conditioning repair service'), the real install photos (Lennox condenser + air handler, smart thermostat), and repeated review themes (repair, installation/replacement, maintenance). All 4 service cards use a 'no-obligation quote' framing instead of invented prices, per the adapted-variant rule.

repair: AC repair / diagnosis for units not cooling, short-cycling or noisy
install_replace: Full AC system replacement (condenser + air handler, Lennox and other major brands)

pricing_note: No prices published by the business on the Google Business Profile or anywhere else found. Site uses 'No-obligation quote' / 'cotizacion sin compromiso' framing throughout (adapted-variant rule), never an invented price.

reviews_selected_for_site_note: Used the 2 fully complete verbatim Google reviews (Guille Miranda, Tessie Bettaglio) plus the Catherine Borges review exactly as Google's own UI truncates it (with its real ellipsis), rather than fabricating or guessing the missing ending. Pablo de los Santos and David W's reviews were used only as research grounding for adapted copy elsewhere on the site, not quoted directly since their text is also truncated and less central.

photos.curation_note: Only 5 real, own, verified photos existed in the full 10-photo GMB album after rejecting 2 duplicates and 3 third-party/text-overlay marketing graphics (see rejected list). This meets but does not exceed the 5-photo minimum: per FORGE-BRIEF's 'menos fotos buenas > rellenar con malas' rule, the gallery was reduced from the skeleton's default 6 tiles to 3 (1 wide + 2 narrow), and the experience section's original 2-image grid was dropped entirely (replaced with 1 image) rather than reuse/duplicate a photo already used elsewhere. No Instagram/Facebook profile exists for this business (see social_media.evidence) so there was no rescue source for additional photos; this is a research-complete result, not research_degradado.

palette_plan.base_skeleton: templates/dark-v2/index.html (Pure Artistry: dark bg #0f0b07, gold #d4a84b/#b8934a, Booksy 121705, Orlando, hair niche)
palette_plan.rationale: A cool steel/ice blue (~207deg, accent-deep #2d6ca8 / accent-mid #5b9bd5) was chosen to thematically match AC/cooling, and sits far from every palette SKELETONS-V2.md lists as already used (coral ~350, caramelo ~33, esmeralda ~150, teal acero ~175, violeta ~265, rosa dark, gold dark ~38). Background shifted from warm near-black (#0f0b07) to a cool near-black (#0a0e12) for coherence; the merktop-badge block was protected during the palette swap and remains gold as required.
